name: Finity
shortDescription: A sleek, modern, immersive Jellyfin theme with complete and minimal variants and configurable colors, roundness, and blur.
description:
Finity is a sleek, modern, immersive theme for Jellyfin, available as a complete build or a lighter minimal build.

Colors, roundness, blur, and spacing can be customized by copying variables from the CSS file, and the theme requires an up-to-date browser for its backdrop gradient effects.
